facts.fact: The DHIS2 for Education report says the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education has published education data in its Statistical Yearbook since 2014, compiled from questionnaires collected at schools each November and published the following May, and refers to the 2026 Statistical Yearbook.
The report says the Statistical Yearbook is compiled from questionnaires collected at schools.
The report says the ministry has published the yearbook annually since 2014 and its minister wrote a preface to the 2026 edition.

GMB.note: The annual school census mentioned is a facility survey, not a population census or household survey.
The document states nothing on data centres.
The Education Data Center consolidates sources into one repository; the document does not describe an exchange between separate education systems or a shared learner identifier.

facts.fact: The report says the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education began implementing a DHIS2-based EMIS in 2018 and has since added daily attendance reporting, learner records and dashboards, with the annual school census among the sources now consolidated in the Education Data Center.
The report says individual-level learner records were added to the ministry's DHIS2-based EMIS after 2018; it gives no unique learner number or national coverage.
